title: reviewer-media
description: Team layer of the reviewer-media concern (docs/conventions/reviewer-media.yaml): when /review:reviewer-media builds narrated review media for a pull request, and the values it hands the voice, the renderer and the pull-request media action.

policy.description: When media are built: never, on-request (default), when-selected or always; docs/conventions/reviewer-media.md, The policy.

requested.description: The label that asks for media; false turns it off.

posted.description: The label set once media are posted; false turns it off.

failed.description: The label set when a build fails for good; false turns it off.

voice_chain.description: Voice backends to try in order, passed to /speech:narrate as --backend-chain, which names the backends it accepts.

voices.description: The voice per backend, passed as --voice <backend>:<voice>.

voice_command.description: Team-only: the command backend's template, {script} in and {out} WAV out. Read from the base commit only, since it runs a command.

allow_unattended_paid_voice.description: Team-only: let an unattended run call a paid voice backend.

ui_paths.description: Globs of paths whose change makes the storyboard include screenshot moments.

upload_limit_mb.description: The largest video the pull request attaches; a larger one is split at chapters locally or linked as an Actions artifact.

artifact_retention_days.description: Days an Actions artifact holding the media is kept, 1 to 90, so media never add storage billing.
